lines.en: Sssss, creeping toward you.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，找还能用的补给。
lines.en: I shuffle along, looking for usable supplies.

lines.zh: 发出沙哑叫声，四处巡视。
lines.en: Croaking noisily, scanning the area.
Crawling forward, vigilant.
Creeping closer, eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中逼近，眼神凶狠。
lines.en: Sssss, advancing with fierce eyes.

lines.zh: 缓慢蠕动，发出轻微叫声。
lines.en: Crawling slowly, croaking softly.
Moving in shadows.
Searching for food, sssssing.

lines.zh: 缓缓爬行，警惕敌人的动静。
lines.en: Crawling slowly, listening for threats.

lines.zh: 我沿着断墙走，不敢走大路。
lines.en: I follow the broken walls, never the open road.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩实了才落脚。
lines.en: I set each foot down only after testing it.
Lying quietly on the ground.
Lazily basking in the sun.
Staying still in the shade.
Lying still in ruins.
Staring into the distance.
Waiting quietly for prey.

lines.zh: 我蹲在玻璃碴后面不动。
lines.en: I crouch still behind the broken glass.
Lying quietly in the dark.
Waiting quietly for companions.
Curling quietly into a corner.
Staring at you, cold eyes.

lines.zh: 盯着你看，似乎有话要说。
lines.en: Staring at you, with something to say.
Fixing you in sight, ready to attack.
Staring at you, like you're prey.
Staring at you, searching for weaknesses.
Staring at you with hollow eyes.
Staring at you, waiting for an opportunity.
Staring at you, trying to scare you off.
Staring at you, ready to fight.
Staring at you, like it can read minds.
Ouch, bitten!
My arm!
Leg injury.
I'm almost out of bandages.
The cloth strips are gone and I'm still bleeding.
Got a wound.
Stop, it hurts!
Please, stop hitting me!
Serious injury.
Needs medical.
Will you scare me with a torch?
I'm hungry, want meat.
Do you have bread?

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，再近一步试试。
lines.en: That meat in your hand—one step closer, I dare you.

lines.zh: 给我点吃的，你不会吃亏。
lines.en: Give me food, you won't lose out.

lines.zh: 我不会攻击你的，但别逼我。
lines.en: I won't attack you, but don't逼 me.
I need a torch, for light.
Can you give me some gold?

lines.zh: 我找到了食物，和你分享。
lines.en: I found food, to share with you.
Don't be afraid, I'm just a survivor.
We collided, what do you think?
I bumped into you, sorry.
You bumped my bad leg.
You knocked me over, mad?
Don't bump into me, I'm a bit scary.
You bumped into me, how does that feel?
I bumped into you, sorry.
Be careful, I'm a bit clumsy.

lines.zh: 我不小心撞上了，求原谅。
lines.en: I accidentally bumped, forgive me.

lines.zh: 我们撞到了一起，现在怎么办？
lines.en: We collided, now what?

lines.zh: 末日后，我想有个人守夜。
lines.en: After the end, I want someone to share the watch.

lines.zh: 我一个人守了三个冬天。
lines.en: I've held out three winters alone.
Find a mate, survive.

lines.zh: 一个人守了三个冬天，够了。
lines.en: Three winters alone is enough.
You're my only hope.
In this world, you still want children?

lines.zh: 末日后，我只想有个人说话。
lines.en: After the end, I just want someone to talk to.
We need to reproduce to survive.

lines.zh: 和我交配，我们能活下去。
lines.en: Mate with me, we can survive.

lines.zh: 分你半块面包，换你留下。
lines.en: Half my bread, if you stay.
Take a bite of the rotten flesh.
Help me lift this concrete slab.
Don't move, that's my food.

lines.zh: 你看起来可以当我的同伴。
lines.en: You look like a good companion.
It's too dangerous here, follow me.
Watch out, there's an enemy!
Give me something to eat!

lines.zh: 这栋楼的楼梯口归我守。
lines.en: I hold the stairwell of this building.
You smell it, the scent of blood.
Take me, I can help you.
See that? My prey.
Hand over your food and water.

lines.zh: 你鞋底的声音我记住了。
lines.en: I've memorized the sound of your soles.

lines.zh: 你把背包带子勒紧了，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you tighten your pack strap.
That leg wound is slowing you down.

lines.zh: 你拿走了我的水，我记着。
lines.en: You took my water; I remember.
You wait here for me.
I'll catch up with you.
Don't let me find you again.
You smell recently dead.

lines.zh: 站住，先让我看清你的脸。
lines.en: Stop. Let me see your face first.
Are you human, or one of them?
My hands are shaking. Do not push me.
I claimed these ruins first.
Is something following you?
You're going to be eaten.

lines.zh: 我撑不住了，你也别想走。
lines.en: I'm done for — and you won't leave either.
You can't escape now.
All of you are in my pen.
Leave the pack, back away.

lines.zh: 末日里，我盯上你的背包。
lines.en: In this wasteland, I've got my eye on your pack.

lines.zh: 我记住你背包的颜色了。
lines.en: I remember the color of your pack.
Behind you is a collapsed wall.
I won't let you live.
I strike first. Do not blame me.

lines.zh: 只剩半块面包，谁也别抢。
lines.en: Half a loaf left. Nobody takes it.
Stay away from my pack.
I count to three and you step back.
I dare not sleep, and I cannot lose.
I want your water flask.
Living matters more than reasoning.
I sharpened this blade myself.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的伤口在渗血。
lines.en: Stay back; my wound is still seeping.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，靠近我，就死定了！
lines.en: Sssss, come closer, and you're done!
I bite because I've been hungry too long.
Stop panting; save your breath.
Get bitten!
Rip your flesh!
Don't duck your neck; I bite true.

lines.zh: 牙磨了三天，就等这一口。
lines.en: I ground my teeth for three days for this bite.

lines.zh: 我咬人，是因为先被咬过。
lines.en: I bite because I was bitten first.
Hands off. That's my ration.
Here, take this to the grave!
Get away. I only want supplies!
This cut is self-defense!
Do not make me kill you!
I have fought worse than you!
Your blood will draw the horde!
We break off after this. Do not chase me!
Hunger drives me to find food!
Where's the prey?
Humans around!
Starving, find food fast!
Need to feed!
Search for food, survive!
Find something to eat!
Humans nearby!
Find something to eat, regain strength!
Find food to survive!

lines.zh: 我在这堆瓦砾里躲了三天。
lines.en: I hid in this rubble for three days.

lines.zh: 城里还剩我一个活人吗？
lines.en: Am I the last living soul in this city?
The fire still burns, so someone is here.

lines.zh: 我从尸群边上摸了回来。
lines.en: I slipped back past the horde.

lines.zh: 袖子烧起来，我在地上滚。
lines.en: My sleeve catches fire and I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从瓦砾堆上滚了下来。
lines.en: I rolled down a heap of rubble.

lines.zh: 污水灌进喉咙，我抓不住岸。
lines.en: Foul water fills my throat; I can't grip the bank.

lines.zh: 爆炸把耳膜震得嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast left my ears ringing.
Hit by projectile.

lines.zh: 那股紫光钻进了我的骨头。
lines.en: That violet light crawled into my bones.
Half a biscuit left in my bag.
Lightning struck; I clutched my supplies.
Fell into the void.
